description:
48V 500W Rear Hub Motor

The ACE is built around a 48V 500W rear hub motor tuned for the perfect power-to-weight ratio. It delivers smooth, punchy acceleration without the bulk of larger motors — giving you a nimble, responsive ride whether you're darting through city traffic or pushing hard on an open road.

Frame-Integrated 48V 15Ah Battery

The ACE's 48V 15Ah battery is stealthily integrated into the frame — hidden from dust, weather, and theft. This isn't just about looks. Keeping the battery internal protects it from the elements and keeps the center of gravity low for better handling. With a range of 40 to 70 miles per charge, it covers your daily needs without compromise.

Shimano 7-Speed Drivetrain

A Shimano 7-speed derailleur puts you in control of your effort on any terrain. Pair it with the motor assist and you have a wide range of combinations — pedal easy on flat roads, drop into a lower gear for climbs, or push hard with minimal assist when you want the workout. Reliable, precise shifting every time.

180mm Hydraulic Disc Brakes

Large 180mm hydraulic disc brakes deliver confident, fade-free stopping power in all conditions. Whether you're coming to a quick stop in traffic or slowing down on a wet descent, the brakes respond firmly and evenly — giving you full control without having to think twice about it.

20" x 3.0" Kenda All-Terrain Tires

The ACE rides on 20" x 3.0" Kenda puncture-resistant tires — wide enough for solid grip and stability on varied surfaces, but lighter and more nimble than full fat tires. You get the confidence of all-terrain capability without the sluggish feel, making the ACE equally at home on city streets and weekend trails.
